data.name: Avadh
data.long_meaning: Avadh is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'vidh' which means 'to know'. The name is associated with knowledge, wisdom, and learning. This region was a hub of learning and intellectual activity, attracting scholars and sages from all corners of the world. The name represents a connection to this rich cultural heritage, one that is deeply rooted in the tradition of knowledge and wisdom.
